text:
anya (growth): Quick sync re: next Wed office-hours + 3 breakout rooms. Need owners for reg page segmentation, breakout links, caption quality, and post-event lead routing. Can we lock today?
mike (events): I can do Zoom + breakout setup. Plan: single meeting + pre-assigned breakout rooms. Will create unique join links per room and list them in the confirmation email. Need the reg fields and HubSpot mapping.
tess (producer): Ill own capture + captions. Two asks: 1) we want per-breakout recordings saved separately, 2) run our caption-correction script against Zoom transcript before publish. Ill need an S3 path and service account.
ravi (product): Ill build the reg page. Fields: first, last, email, company, role, timezone, preferred breakout (dropdown), recording_consent (yes/no), short use-case. Hidden UTMs and a `skip_social` flag for paid exclusion.
anya (growth): HubSpot mapping: campaign=office-hours-apr, source=webinar, map preferred_breakout -> contact property `oh_preference`, recording_consent -> `webinar_consent`. Also add lifecycle stage=lead on registration.
mike (events): Zoom checklist: require registration (auto-approve), enable cloud recording per breakout, auto-transcript ON, disable file transfer, set chat host-only during main session, allow attendees to join breakouts automatically. Alternative hosts: tess + ravi. I'll post breakout link map in thread.
tess (producer): Caption plan: download Zoom VTT -> run `caption_cleaner.py --model=fast --lexicon=product_terms.txt` -> output `.vtt` and plain `.txt`. I'll upload final files to `s3://redwood-marketing/office-hours/2026-04-21/`. Need write access for service-account `marketing-producer@redwood.iam`.
ravi (product): Add a small consent checkbox that populates `skip_social` so Zapier can filter. Also include `publish_pref` dropdown (public/internal/no-publish). We'll respect that in post-event flow.
anya (growth): Post-event cadence proposed: Day0: thanks + calendar + private replay link; Day1: breakouts recap email to segment by preferred_breakout (include breakout-specific clip); Day4: highlights + CTA; Day10: nurture invite. Tess who drafts breakout clips?
tess (producer): Ill cut 3x 90s breakout clips and 1x 2-min highlights. Upload raw within 4h and clips within 24h. For accessibility Ill provide `.vtt` + `.txt`. If someone chose no-publish, I will scrub their audio using timecodes from Zoom transcript before release.
mike (events): Ops pin I'll post: 1) Reg page live + test registrant, 2) Zoom meeting + breakout links posted, 3) Producer local backup confirmed, 4) Zapier -> HubSpot mapping validated, 5) Pre-show run at T-20.
anya (growth): Who owns Day1 breakout-specific email copy? Ill draft main template, Ravi can add product-specific CTAs per breakout.
ravi (product): Happy to add CTAs. Also note: drop a slide at the top of each breakout reminding attendees about PII & chat rules.
zoombot: Meeting created: "Redwood Office Hours: Breakouts" Wed 2026-04-21 17:00 UTC. Recording: cloud enabled, breakouts recorded separately.
